_transcript: [m0][00:00][client] I sent money to my brokerage account and it hasn't shown up. It's making me nervous.

[m2][00:03][bot] By continuing this conversation, you agree to the collection and processing of your personal data and confirm that you have read the company's Privacy Policy.

[m6][01:14][client] Yes
[m7][01:15][bot] Please wait. An agent will join the chat shortly.

[m10][02:43][operator] Hello, I'm Sam. I understand why you'd want to check. We'll need to verify your identity before we look at the account.
[m11][02:55][client] Okay.
[m12][03:13][system] Customer identity verified.
[m13][03:40][operator] Thanks. What currency did you send?
[m14][04:10][client] US dollars.
[m15][04:58][operator] I've sent the case for review with the currency you provided. We'll follow up in this chat once there's an update.

[m20][06:49][operator] I've added that timing to the case. The team will check the brokerage side.

[m27][10:34][operator] Yes, select the start and end dates for the period you need, then download the report.
[m28][10:53][client] That worked. I'll wait here for the transfer update.
[m29][11:29][operator] You're welcome. We'll follow up here about the transfer. Goodbye!
